personality: 3 Editorial structure with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK surfaces
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, institutional dark-mode experience that elevates Italian heritage through deep navy, vibrant orange, and sophisticated serif typography.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing (xl/2xl) to allow the deep navy background to breathe. Avoid dense packing.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays (dark navy tinted) on featured hero cards over the Milan architecture image.
Use glass on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Ensure a translucent tinted base (≥75% opacity) underneath foreground text on any glass over images.
dont's: Do not use glass on form fields or standard list rows.
Do not skip the gradient-to-dark scrim on the full-screen video feed.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A premium editorial feed showcasing the initiative, Italian heritage, and featured applications.

states.empty: Should not be empty; fallback to static institutional description.
states.error: Message 'Unable to load feed' with a refined retry button.

screens.layout: Hero section featuring the Milan architecture image with a top-to-bottom dark scrim and Cormorant Garamond display text. Below, a horizontal scroll of 'Featured Applications' (glass-elevated cards) and editorial blocks detailing the 'Made in Italy' mission.

screens.name: Candidati (Apply)
screens.purpose: A sophisticated multi-step submission flow for businesses to upload their video and select their heritage pillar.
screens.layout: Step 1: Video selection/recording. Step 2: Business description input. Step 3: A 2-column grid or elegant list of the 5 Pillars (Saper Fare, Gusto, Creatività, Commercio, Identità) featuring subtle blurred artisan background images in each card. Floating sticky 'Submit' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Classifica (Video Feed)
screens.purpose: A cinematic, full-screen vertical scrolling video feed for public voting and discovering excellence.

states.loading: Skeleton video placeholders with a shimmer effect.
states.empty: Icon of a soaring falcon + 'Nessuna candidatura ancora.'

screens.layout: Full-screen video player (TikTok-style but elegant). Absolutely positioned dark vertical gradient scrim at the bottom (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to ensure text legibility. Business name in Cormorant Garamond, description in Satoshi. Right-side or bottom-aligned floating actions (Like/Vote, Share) using Phosphor icons.

screens.name: Tour Nazionale
screens.purpose: List of the 80 seminars across 20 regions, celebrating generational succession.
screens.layout: Top half: Abstract map or hero graphic representing Italy's regions. Bottom half: A generous, cleanly spaced list of cities and dates. Each row has the date prominent on the left, city/seminar title on the right. 'surfaceSecondary' used for active/upcoming stops.

screens.name: Profile & Auth
screens.purpose: Authentication and user hub for tracking submitted applications.

states.empty: Illustration of the falcon, 'Log in to view your legacy'.

screens.layout: Auth: Single column, labels above inputs, minimalist lines. Profile: Header with the soaring falcon image as a background banner with a dark scrim, user details overlaid. Below, a grid of their submitted mini-videos.

hero_milan_architecture.alt: Aerial view of Milan modern architecture at golden hour

category_artisan.alt: Italian artisan working in a leather shop

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the Dark Navy (#0F1A2A) and Orange (#F57C00) palette requested by the user. Do not introduce indigo, purple, or generic tech blues.
Typography must use Cormorant Garamond (max weight 500) for display/headers to maintain the editorial/institutional feel, and Satoshi for body text.
Implement the 'Classifica' (Video Feed) with a mandatory vertical gradient-to-dark scrim (top transparent -> bottom 80% surface) to ensure the white text is readable over user-uploaded videos.
Use glassmorphism (expo-glass-effect/expo-blur) for sticky headers, the bottom tab bar, and featured application cards on the Home screen to elevate the 'Luxe' feel.
For the 'Candidati' screen, implement the 5 pillars (Saper Fare, Gusto, Creatività, Commercio, Identità) as elegant selectable cards, utilizing the artisan image as a subtle background.
Ensure all buttons and inputs respect the minimum 44x44pt touch targets.
Wire up haptic feedback for primary actions like voting on videos (impactMedium) and tab changes (selection).
